scope: Optional permanent runner access: nullable outer lease expiry, bounded derived capabilities, existing-data migration, authorization consumers, proxy/supervisor, UI and documentation.
verdict: No blocking findings remain in the reviewed source after actual Claude Opus 5.5 closeout.

acceptedFindings.problem: A strict local-clock 900-second upper bound rejected a legitimate 900-second capability from a slightly faster Hub clock.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Fixed validation ceiling at 900 + 60 seconds of local remaining time. Hub issuance remains strictly 1..900 seconds and derived capability expiry is NOT NULL. Regression rejects missing/null/string/expired/overlong values and accepts five seconds of Hub clock lead.

acceptedFindings.problem: A global foreign_key_check could block the expiry-constraint migration due to an unrelated historical orphan.
acceptedFindings.resolution: Integrity checks scoped to evolved_runner_leases and evolved_capabilities inside the same IMMEDIATE transaction. A genuine legacy-schema fixture preserves unrelated corruption without changing it; a broken capability-to-lease FK still rolls back the expiry constraint change.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Rebuild the lease table with foreign_keys disabled.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Superseded. Pinned Bun 1.3.14 contains SQLite 3.53.0, whose direct ALTER COLUMN DROP NOT NULL preserves table identity and needs no FK disable. Independent synthetic local and isolated VM-image probes passed.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Allow nullable expiry in both lease and capability SQL branches.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Rejected. Only outer lease expiry is nullable; capability expiry remains strict and finite.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Promise supervisor revocation within two seconds.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Rejected. Loop delay plus network timeout can exceed two seconds; no exact timing claim is made.

rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.advice: Project-role restoration can resurrect a previously revoked lease.
rejectedOrSupersededAdvice.disposition: Rejected by source and corrected by Claude closeout. Project membership PUT and DELETE transactionally revoke both capabilities and leases; role restoration does not clear revoked_at.

nonblockingNotes.note: Proxy rejection test uses a 961000-ms future timestamp, only one second above the 960-second validation boundary. Extremely delayed CI could make that specific case timing-sensitive.
nonblockingNotes.disposition: Resolved after review by increasing the invalid timestamp to 990000 ms and rerunning the proxy suite.

nonblockingNotes.note: An existing FK violation in the lease or capability tables makes this migration fail closed and requires operator diagnosis.
nonblockingNotes.disposition: Intended integrity behavior; no silent repair or deletion.

preservedRequirements: Only explicit API expiresInSeconds:null creates a permanent lease; omitted API lifetime remains 24 hours.
Existing finite, expired and revoked leases retain their exact values and authorization status.
Permanent leases remain revocable and subject to current project membership, administrator role, profile and scope gates.
Derived capabilities remain at most 900 seconds with non-null expiry.
Browser default permanent access remains explicitly selectable alongside bounded temporary access; provider authentication and Runner provisioning remain separate.

primarySources.claim: Section 6 documents ALTER COLUMN SET/DROP NOT NULL beginning with SQLite 3.53.0 (2026-04-09).

limits: This record evaluates code readiness, not deployment success.
Tests use synthetic/local credentials and provider fixtures; no real provider subscription login or GitHub push was performed by the reviewer.
No existing user database or secret value was inspected or mutated by this review.
Raw Claude output and prompts remain outside the repository; this record contains sanitized dispositions and hashes.

postReviewChanges.change: The rejected overlong capability fixture now uses 990000 ms instead of 961000 ms, retaining a 30-second margin above the same 960-second validation bound; proxy tests passed again.
The isolated acceptance instructions explicitly select Befristet because the user-facing default is now permanent.
